notes.title: ​​「Mobile Fortress: Pursuit Mode」Launches on May 20​​
notes.content:
The mobile fortress carrying the protagonist and heroines was once an all-powerful stronghold, destroyed by the Witch and reduced to a mere vehicle. Now, by recovering its core parts during adventures, players can restore it to battle endless waves of pursuers!

​​Key Features​​
-- Clear enemies, defeat bosses, and gather materials/ammo to upgrade the fortress.
-- Elevate fortress tiers, research tech to boost combat capabilities.
-- Defeat bosses to claim loot, unlock Collectibles that enhance fortress, heroes, and protagonist’s stats/passives.
-- Collectibles can be upgraded and awakened, boosting both Pursuit Mode and main gameplay progression.

notes.title: Server Migration Announcement
notes.content: In order to provide a more stable gaming environment for everyone, we will be relocating our server nodes from overseas to domestically on the morning of April 11th. It is conservatively estimated that the server migration will take 2 hours, from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM (GMT+8) on April 11th. If the deployment is completed early and the environment proves to be stable, access will be opened ahead of schedule. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

Dear players, hello everyone.

We will perform a maintenance update today at 17:00 (GMT+8) to address some recent bugs and optimize certain rules and experiences, all based on your valuable suggestions and feedback. Thank you very much. The maintenance details are as follows:

1, Launch the customizable gift pack event, allowing you to choose and combine the gift pack content you want.
2, Optimize the secret realm’s automatic dice rolling function; if stepping on a trap results in reduced rewards, actions such as mining or opening treasure chests will be automatically canceled to avoid losses.
3, At the end of the secret realm challenge, using the horn will trigger a hidden Boss battle, where high-level hidden Bosses will have their level and combat power optimized and reduced.

notes.title: Game Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Dear players, hello everyone.
We will perform a maintenance update today at 17:00 (GMT+8) to address some bugs that have recently occurred and optimize some rules and experiences, all based on the suggestions and opinions provided by everyone. Thank you very much. The maintenance details are as follows:

1，The time detection and judgment for various gameplay modes will now be consistent with GMT+8.

2，Fixed the issue where the volume on the login screen was not controlled by the system volume.

3，Fixed the issue of being unable to claim guild red envelopes.
Because the guild red envelopes were made available for everyone without an expiration limit, the accumulated data became too large to read and display. The rules have been optimized:
--1. The number of claims per guild red envelope is limited to 20, with the largest one limited to 30; once fully claimed, it stops.
--2. These envelopes will last for a maximum of one day; even if not all claimed, the data will be cleared.
--3. For envelopes that have been fully claimed, the information will be retained for 1 hour so you can see who was the luckiest, and then the data will be cleared.

4，The daily sent magic crystals have been increased from 20,000 to 28,000.

5，The base guaranteed output for alchemy exchange for gold coins has been increased by approximately 5 times.

6，On Saturday, Sunday, and Monday, the gift package content will be standardized to (10K diamonds + 2 red phantom eggs).

7，In the secret realm, an automatic dice rolling feature has been added. You can set default handling options for certain events, allowing them to run automatically without closing the secret realm interface.

8，Daily special gift package outputs have been adjusted (the number of advanced summoning stones is changed to 10, the number of top-tier spirit talismans to 10, the number of re-cast emblems to 50, and the prices of the golden key and golden pickaxe to 10).

9，The daily gift package now allows the purchase of 3 red phantom eggs per day instead of 1.

notes.title: Game Maintenance Notice
notes.content:

notes.title: Game Update and Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Dear Players,​
We sincerely apologize for the abrupt removal of premium packages. While our intention was to balance the game, it inadvertently compromised the experience for non-paying players seeking premium enjoyment. After discussions with the community, we are implementing the following adjustments:

​Package pop-up duration extended to 60 days (temporary solution to minimize code changes and potential bugs)
​**"Super Value Packages" consolidated into daily refresh format** (all weekly/monthly packages removed; daily purchase limit: 1)
​Red dot notification added: Displayed upon login if unsold packages exist, disappearing after first view (reactivates on next login if packages remain)
​**"Forbidden Trials" rewards standardized with Arena rewards** (only base coins and cosmetic titles; PVP focuses on fair competition)
Maintenance begins at ​00:50 (GMT+8) with 10-minute downtime. ​40,000 Gems will be compensated globally post-maintenance. We appreciate your patience and constructive feedback in community discussions.

notes.title: Adjustment of Competitive Ranking Rewards
notes.content:
Dear Players,
In light of feedback from several players suggesting that in a fair environment the rewards in PVP should not have such a wide disparity in gains—which in turn pressures the casual gaming experience—we fully agree with and appreciate this input. Therefore, we will soon perform a hot update to adjust the rewards for arena-based gameplay to only grant a small amount of gold, as well as symbolic items like titles and avatar frames. In a fair environment, PVP should simply be an exchange of strategic formations rather than a suppressive experience akin to that of pay-to-win players. We once again thank the player who pointed out this issue and sincerely apologize for the negative experience.

notes.title: Announcement of Bug Fixes, Feature Adjustments, and Launching a New Server
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Over the past two days, due to our oversight and some ill-considered functions and gameplay designs, several serious bugs and balance issues have arisen, resulting in a suboptimal experience for players and straying from our goal of fair play for non-paying users. We appreciate everyone for pointing out the issues and bugs. After careful discussion, we have decided to perform maintenance and adjustments on the afternoon of March 26. The fixes and adjustments are as follows:

1，Disable the pop-up gift pack feature. Although it was intended to provide a random surprise, it ended up causing more anxiety, so we have decided to cancel this feature.
2，Disable the gift pack feature. Since it was hidden deep within the interface, some players did not notice it, and misinformation led to some players not using the magic crystals as cost-effectively as possible. Thus, we have decided to cancel this feature as well.
3，We will promptly adjust resource outputs in the future so that more resources can be obtained fairly through the daily shop and the gacha system.
4，Fix the issue where the in-game compendium was not fully displayed due to a previous pool bug.
5，Fix the bug in the soul reforge system that allowed awakened souls to be exchanged by mistake. This was due to our oversight—the awakening system was not yet completed, and test data caused errors during reforging. After the fix, such errors will no longer occur, and the entrance to the awakening system will be temporarily disabled until the gameplay is fully developed.
6，The awakened souls obtained due to issue 5 are test data, and using them in-game may cause errors or freezes. During maintenance, they will be replaced with the corresponding SSSR souls.
7，Add volume control to the system settings menu to resolve the issue of the volume not being adjustable.
8，Add quick navigation buttons to the character artwork (kanban musume) interface, allowing direct access to the modification screens for character artwork and background boards.

The above maintenance and fixes will be carried out on March 26 at 17:30 (GMT+8), with an expected duration of 20 minutes. Once completed, a new server will be launched at 18:00 (GMT+8) so that players who experienced an unfair start or made poor cultivation decisions due to these issues can start over. The original server will remain available. After maintenance, all players on Server 1 will receive a compensation of 20,000 magic crystals.

Thank you for your understanding and feedback. We sincerely apologize once again—your criticism and understanding are the driving forces behind our progress.

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions
notes.content:
1，The daily 20,000 Magic Crystals are automatically credited to the player's account upon login, so there is no need to claim them.
2，Even if you haven't logged in for several days, when you log in again, the Magic Crystals for those days will be credited to your account together.
3，The game server node is located in Asia; the time used is not Beijing Time (UTC+8) but is 8 hours behind Beijing Time.
4，The male protagonist's avatar serves as the entrance to the system settings. Once inside, you can set the cards you have obtained as display characters (kanban girls) on the left and right sides under "Change Decoration."

notes.title: Announcement on Gacha Pool Bugs
notes.content:
Dear players, due to an error in the game configuration, the card pools for regular draws and for other events and items are inconsistent. We would like to thank the players who pointed out the issue in the comments section and sincerely apologize for the poor experience caused.
We will promptly fix the configuration error in the card pools, and within 24 hours resolve the compendium synchronization issue by releasing an update patch.
Our original intention for adopting the one-time purchase model was to eliminate microtransactions, prevent progress from being hindered, and restrict the card pools. This bug was purely due to our own negligence, and we hope you will continue to help us improve. We will update the content more diligently.

notes.title: Update and Maintenance Announcement on March 25th, 21:00 (GMT+8)
notes.content:
Dear Players,
We apologize for interrupting your gameplay. A brief maintenance and patch update will occur on ​March 25th at 21:00 (GMT+8).
Fixes:

Extended pop-up bundle availability to 24 hours to ensure players without Magic Crystals can purchase it.
Duration: 10 minutes. Please log out before 20:30 and relog after the update.
Compensation: All players will receive ​10,000 Gems via in-game mail.
We sincerely thank the players who reported this issue and apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: Announcement of the End of This Playtest
notes.content:
The demo version of the Girl's Mobile Castle in October will end at 19:00 on October 14, 2024.

Thank you to all the players who participated in the demo trial. We will end the current demo version trial at 19:00 on October 14, 2024.

We appreciate everyone's enthusiasm and the feedback and suggestions you have given us! We plan to update the content on November 8, 2024, based on player feedback and suggestions, fix some issues, optimize, and then reopen the demo version.

In the next trial demo version, we plan to update: 
--Fix known bugs and optimize the game's smooth operation. 
--Open the Soul Mill gameplay, allowing the exchange of existing souls, with a probability of obtaining souls not yet owned. 
--Update multiple languages, including English and Japanese.

In the official version, we will continue to update more characters, more exquisite character illustrations, personal storylines, and more rich content.

Thank you, everyone.

notes.title: The Girl's Moving Castle, the demo is about to set sail
notes.content:
We are delighted to finally introduce "The Girl's Mobile Castle" to everyone! We will open the demo version of the game for everyone to try on October 8, 2024. "The Girl's Mobile Castle" is a one-time purchase, no in-game purchases card game with a casual idle placement style, Q-version painting style, a world that is a bit absurd, allowing you to collect easily, focus on strategy, and arrange troops to play. You can interact with other players, compete, and also form a guild to participate in multiplayer gameplay. There is no fear of being dominated by the rich, only full of free benefits, easy social interaction, and battle strategy.

In this demo version, you can experience the following gameplay: 

-- Soul drawing and cultivation gameplay 

-- Mainline story level battles 

-- Dungeon challenge gameplay 

-- Adventure treasure hunting gameplay 

-- Guild gameplay 

-- Arena gameplay

The official version will continue to update more characters, more exquisite character illustrations, and personal storylines, and more rich content.

Thank you for your attention, and we hope you have a pleasant experience in the demo version.
